responses:
Here's what you can try for your VIBRO (not turning on, no LED):

1. *Check the power switch* — make sure the switch on the back is ON and the power cord is firmly plugged into a working wall socket.

2. *Check the fuse* — there's a small fuse holder near the power inlet. Open it (usually by twisting or sliding) and see if the thin wire inside is broken or blackened. If yes, the fuse has blown and needs to be replaced (our technician can do this).

3. *Try a different power socket* — plug the VIBRO adapter into another wall socket to rule out a dead socket.

If none of these help, please tap *Register Complaint* below — our field engineer will visit and check the internal power supply. 🙏
intents.title: Vibro — Not Turning On (No LED)
intents.description: Vibro machine is not working or LED is off

responses:
If your VIBRO keeps vibrating without stopping, here's what to check:

1. *Check the timer knob* — at the bottom of the VIBRO there is a small timer dial. Make sure it is set to the correct time (not turned past the maximum position). Turn it back to a middle position and try again.

2. *Reset the machine* — switch off the VIBRO from the back, wait 30 seconds, then switch it on again.

If the issue continues, please tap *Register Complaint* — our technician will inspect the timer circuit. 🙏
intents.title: Vibro — Continuous Vibrating
intents.description: Machine is continuously vibrating without stopping

responses:
If your VIBRO is producing weak vibration, try these checks:

1. *Check the adapter LED* — look at the small LED on the power adapter (the wall plug). It should glow steadily when the VIBRO is ON. If the LED is dim, flickering, or off, the adapter is likely faulty and needs replacement.

2. *Check the frequency knob* — at the bottom of the VIBRO there is a frequency adjustment dial. Try turning it slightly clockwise to increase vibration strength.

If vibration is still weak, please tap *Register Complaint* — our technician will check the internal vibrator coil. 🙏
intents.title: Vibro — Low Vibration
intents.description: Vibration strength is too low

responses:
If your Compact Adapter seems to have no output, please try these steps:

1. *Check the LED on the adapter* — there is a small status LED on the adapter body. If it is OFF, the adapter is not receiving power from the wall.

2. *Check the wall socket* — try plugging the adapter into a different wall socket. Also make sure the switch on the wall socket is ON.

3. *Check the AC cord* — make sure the cord going into the adapter is fully inserted at both ends.

If the LED still does not glow after these checks, the adapter is likely faulty and needs replacement. Please tap *Register Complaint*. 🙏
intents.title: Compact Adapter — No Output
intents.description: Compact Adapter not delivering power to the machine

responses:
If your Charger Adapter is not charging the machine, please try these:

1. *Check the status LED on the adapter* — if it is OFF, the adapter is not receiving power.

2. *Check the fuse inside the adapter* — some charger adapters have a small user-replaceable fuse near the power inlet. If you can see it is broken/blackened, replace it with one of the same rating.

3. *Check the AC cord and wall switch* — make sure the cord is plugged in firmly at both ends and the wall switch is ON.

If the charger still does not work, please tap *Register Complaint* for an adapter replacement. 🙏
intents.title: Charger Adapter — No Output
intents.description: Charger Adapter not delivering power

patterns: My ANALYZER is not turning on
responses:
If your Milk Analyzer is not turning on, please try these steps:

1. *Check the wall socket* — make sure the analyzer's power cord is firmly plugged into a working wall socket, and the wall switch is ON.

2. *Check the power switch on the analyzer* — there is a rocker switch on the back. Make sure it is in the ON position (I).

3. *Check the fuse on the analyzer* — the analyzer has a small fuse near the power inlet. If the thin wire inside is broken or the glass is blackened, the fuse has blown. Our technician can replace it.

4. *Check the adapter* — if your analyzer runs on an external adapter, make sure the adapter LED is glowing. If not, the adapter may be faulty.

If the analyzer still does not turn on, please tap *Register Complaint*. 🙏
intents.title: Analyzer — Not Turning On
intents.description: Milk Analyzer is not powering on

responses:
If your Analyzer is showing a Low Battery error:

1. *Connect the charger* — plug the charger adapter into the analyzer and into the wall socket. Let it charge for at least 2-3 hours.

2. *Check the charger adapter* — the small LED on the charger should glow when connected. If it does not, the charger may be faulty.

3. *Check the analyzer fuse* — if the analyzer still shows low battery even after charging, its internal fuse may have blown.

If charging does not clear the error, please tap *Register Complaint*. 🙏
intents.title: Analyzer — Low Battery Error
intents.description: Analyzer showing low battery error message

responses:
If your Analyzer shows T2 / Temperature Set / Sample Not Found / Air in Milk errors, please try these:

1. *Check the milk sample* — make sure the milk is fresh, properly mixed, and at room temperature (not too hot, not too cold). Re-test with a fresh sample.

2. *Check the small L-plug at the bottom of the sample tube* — make sure it is properly inserted and the rubber O-ring is in place (not torn or missing). The O-ring creates the suction seal.

3. *Check the silicone tube* — look at the thin silicone tube going from the sample holder to the analyzer. Make sure it is not bent sharply, pinched, or cracked.

4. *Clean the sample tube* — run the analyzer's cleaning cycle 2-3 times with warm distilled water.

If the error continues, please tap *Register Complaint* — our technician will inspect the pump and tubing. 🙏
intents.title: Analyzer — T2 / Sample Error
intents.description: T2 / temperature / sample not found / air in milk

responses:
If your Analyzer shows a 'Water in Sensor' or 'Plunge in Water' message:

1. *Drain the sample liquid* — there is still milk or water sitting in the sensor tube. Run the analyzer's cleaning cycle 3-4 times with warm distilled water to flush it out.

2. *Power cycle* — switch off the analyzer, wait 30 seconds, switch it back on, then run a water test.

If the message still appears, please tap *Register Complaint* — the sensor may need professional cleaning. 🙏
intents.title: Analyzer — Water In Sensor
intents.description: Plunge in water or water in sensor

responses:
If your Analyzer shows a Hot Sample Error, it means the milk you tested was warmer than 40°C:

1. *Cool the milk sample* — bring the milk to room temperature (around 25-30°C). You can put the sample bottle in cool water for a few minutes.

2. *Re-test with the cooled sample* — once cooled, run the test again.

If you keep seeing this error even with room-temperature milk, please tap *Register Complaint* — the temperature sensor may need calibration. 🙏
intents.title: Analyzer — Hot Sample Error
intents.description: Hot sample error is shown

responses:
If your Analyzer does not detect a USB pen-drive or keyboard:

1. *Check the USB port* — unplug and re-plug the device firmly into the analyzer's USB port. Try a different USB port if your analyzer has more than one.

2. *Try a different pen-drive or keyboard* — the device itself may be faulty. Try another one to confirm.

3. *Format the pen-drive* — if you are using a pen-drive, make sure it is formatted as FAT32 (not NTFS or exFAT).

If the issue continues, please tap *Register Complaint*. 🙏
intents.title: Analyzer — USB / Keyboard Not Detected
intents.description: Pen-drive and keyboard not detected

responses:
If your Analyzer shows a WiFi / GSM Error:

1. *Check the antenna* — make sure the small antenna on the back of the analyzer is firmly screwed on (do not over-tighten).

2. *Check signal strength* — if you are in a low-signal area, the WiFi or GSM may not connect. Try moving the analyzer closer to a window or the WiFi router.

3. *Re-enter WiFi / SIM details* — go to the analyzer's Settings → WiFi (or GSM), forget the current network, then re-enter the password or SIM PIN.

If it still cannot connect, please tap *Register Complaint*. 🙏
intents.title: Analyzer — WiFi / GSM Error
intents.description: WiFi/GSM error is shown

responses:
If your Analyzer shows the wrong date or time:

1. *Go to Settings → Date & Time* — manually enter the current date and time.

2. *Enable auto-sync* — if your analyzer is connected to WiFi, turn ON 'Auto date & time' so it syncs from the internet.

If the clock keeps losing time, the internal battery may need replacement. Please tap *Register Complaint*. 🙏
intents.title: Analyzer — Wrong Date / Time
intents.description: Date and time not shown correctly

responses:
If your Analyzer is not sending output to a connected computer:

1. *Check the data cable* — make sure the cable between the analyzer and the PC is firmly plugged in at both ends. Try a different cable if you have one.

2. *Check the output settings* — go to Settings → Data Output on the analyzer and confirm the output format is set correctly (ask our support team for the right setting if you are unsure).

If the PC still receives no data, please tap *Register Complaint*. 🙏
intents.title: Analyzer — No Computer Output
intents.description: Computer output not present

responses:
If your external display is not showing test results:

1. *Check the data cable* — make sure the cable from the analyzer to the external display is firmly connected at both ends. Try a different cable if available.

2. *Check the output format* — go to Settings → Data Output on the analyzer and confirm the format matches what the external display expects.

If the display is still blank, please tap *Register Complaint*. 🙏
intents.title: Analyzer — External Display Blank
intents.description: External display not showing the result

responses:
If your Analyzer shows fat reading even when you run a water (zero) test, please try these steps:

1. *Test with another milk sample first* — if the fat reading on a normal milk sample looks correct, the analyzer is probably working fine and just needs a proper zero calibration.

2. *Clean the sensor and tubes* — run the cleaning cycle 3-4 times with warm distilled water to flush out any milk residue left in the sensor.

3. *Run a water-zero test* — after cleaning, run a fresh water sample through the analyzer. The reading should come down to 0.0. (Our technician can guide you through the exact menu steps on the day of the visit.)

If fat still shows in the water test after cleaning, the sensor may need deep cleaning or recalibration. Please tap *Register Complaint*. 🙏
intents.title: Analyzer — Fat Shown In Water
intents.description: Fat reading appearing during water test

responses:
If your Analyzer gives different readings for the same milk sample:

1. *Clean the sample tube* — run the cleaning cycle 3-4 times with warm distilled water. Old milk residue in the tube can cause inconsistent readings.

2. *Check the silicone tube* — look at the thin silicone tube going to the sample holder. If it is bent, cracked, or loose, replace it.

3. *Mix the sample well* — before testing, gently pour the milk between two clean containers 3-4 times to make sure it is fully mixed. Do not shake vigorously (this creates air bubbles).

If readings still vary, please tap *Register Complaint*. 🙏
intents.title: Analyzer — Reading Variation
intents.description: Different readings for the same sample

responses:
If SMS results are not reaching the farmer's phone:

1. *Check the SIM card* — open the analyzer's SIM slot (usually at the back). Make sure the SIM is inserted in the correct direction and is not loose. Also check that the SIM has active validity (not expired) and SMS plan balance.

2. *Check farmer details* — go to the analyzer's farmer list and confirm the farmer's mobile number is entered correctly (with country code 91 if needed).

3. *Check SMS settings* — go to Settings → SMS and confirm 'Enable SMS' is ON and the SMS centre number is set correctly.

If SMS still does not go out, please tap *Register Complaint*. 🙏
intents.title: Analyzer — SMS Not Sent
intents.description: SMS not sent to the farmer

responses:
If farmer details are not showing on your Analyzer:

1. *Check the farmer list* — go to the Farmers menu on the analyzer. Make sure you have actually added farmers to the list (with name, phone number, etc.).

2. *Re-enter farmer details* — if the list is empty, add at least one farmer from the menu before running a test.

If the list still does not appear, please tap *Register Complaint*. 🙏
intents.title: Analyzer — Farmer Details Missing
intents.description: Farmer details not shown on analyzer

responses:
If your Analyzer's printer is not printing receipts:

1. *Check the printer paper* — open the printer cover and make sure paper is loaded correctly (the thermal side facing the print head) and there is enough paper left.

2. *Check the printer settings* — go to Settings → Printer and confirm the printer is enabled.

3. *Power cycle* — switch off the analyzer, wait 30 seconds, switch it back on, then try printing again.

If the printer still does not print, please tap *Register Complaint*. 🙏
intents.title: Analyzer — Printer Not Printing
intents.description: Printer is not printing

responses:
If the rate chart is not appearing on your Analyzer:

1. *Check the rate chart settings* — go to Settings → Rate Chart and confirm you have entered the rates correctly (per fat %, per SNF %, etc.).

2. *Re-enter the rate chart* — if the chart is empty, enter at least one rate entry and save.

If the rate is still not picked up, please tap *Register Complaint*. 🙏
intents.title: Analyzer — Rate Chart Error
intents.description: Rate not taken from the chart or not viewing

responses:
If test results are not uploading to the cloud:

1. *Check WiFi / GSM connectivity* — go to Settings → WiFi (or GSM) and confirm the analyzer is connected to the internet with a strong signal.

2. *Check cloud details* — go to Settings → Cloud and confirm the cloud server address, username, and machine ID are entered correctly.

3. *Confirm machine registration* — log into the cloud web app and confirm this analyzer's machine ID is registered against your account.

If cloud sync still fails, please tap *Register Complaint*. 🙏
intents.title: Analyzer — Cloud Sync Error
intents.description: Tested result to cloud upload error shown
